about: The expedition camp's grounds on Mars, their own place: Mars's planned ground out to the plan's edge and the ball under it, the plan's rocks, the sun, the mast's beam and the sky, with the habitat (its domes, its airlock and the link to it) shown where the camp stands it. The grounds' made pieces are their kit (data/kit/campgrounds.json, from concept K05). Frame: the camp seat's own (data/ground/mars.json places.campgrounds; x across, z along, y up), as the kit's.

planned_rocks.from: game/world/mars/mars.gd:59-77 (PLANNED_BOULDERS, PLANNED_STONES, PLANNED_PEBBLE 0.45, PLANNED_ROCKS_SEED 43, PLANNED_SUNK 0.12, PLANNED_TIP 0.25, PEBBLES_SEEN 40), mars.gd:371-411,438-449 (_planned_rocks and _planned_lying: every rock of the plan in its order, turned, tipped and stretched from the one seed, sunk by its own share of its height alone), game/world/ground/ground.gd:124-134 (PLAN_SIDE, PLAN_REACH 116, MARS_PLAN_LAYOUT); the game draws the plan's rocks out to 160 m from the eye, the stage those on the plan's square inside 116 m, where its heights have the whole say, and within 130 m of the place's middle

places.name: habitat
places.from: the camp's own record (data/scene/camp.json places.grounds) undone: the habitat stands 0.4769 m over the camp seat's level, turned -130.5 degrees (camp_habitat.gd:318-327)

leave_out.why: the planned rocks round the camp seat: these grounds lay the same plan's rocks themselves (planned_rocks), so the habitat's copy would stand twice

lights.from: game/world/sky/sky.gd:87,296-307,339-343 (SUN_ENERGY 1.25, the true Sun's way at full strength over 3 degrees up on Mars); its way as the game's camp shots set it, tools/perf/place.gd:223-226,653-675 (_bring_the_camp_sun: the clock run on in 5-minute steps from the run's start until the Sun stands 35 to 50 degrees over the camp and is going down), worked out from sim/engine/space/orbits/orbits.gd (centre_at, facing_at, MARS_LEAD_AT_START 48.2 degrees, the Sun's pull from Earth's 14,400-minute year, Mars's sol of 72,000 ticks, sim/engine/world/pace.gd) and FirstExpedition.CAMP_FACING_OUT: from minute 0 it is minute 8,630, the Sun 49.95 degrees up, going down 0.016 degrees a minute; turned into the habitat's frame; turned into the camp seat's frame

environment.from: sky.gd:161 (background Palette.SPACE, as everywhere), sky.gd:345 (ambient), mars.gd:31-36 (the butterscotch sky is Mars's air, the fog volume in `haze`, seen against space)

haze.from: game/world/mars/mars.gd:31-37,105-116 (the Air FogVolume: an ellipsoid (Worlds.RADIUS 220 + AIR_HEIGHT 70) x 2 across round Mars's middle, Palette.MARS_HAZE #d9a066, AIR_DENSITY 0.012), game/world/sky/sky.gd:50,56,314-319 (worked out 160 m out, thrown forward 0.5)

stars.from: game/world/sky/sky.gd:19-33,517-544 (SEED 9, STAR_COUNT 1800, SKY_DISTANCE 700: a SphereMesh of radius 0.7 with 4 sides and 2 rings, scaled 0.4 to 1.3, every direction), game/art/materials/star.tres (unshaded #eef2ff); hung here at 1900 m with each star as wide seen from the middle, past everything the stage holds and inside the views' 2000 m reach, as the game hangs them just inside its camera's reach; turned with the place's own axes, where the game turns them with the world's spin and the hour, which the record does not carry

dust.from: game/outside/dust/mars_wind.gd:17-52,190-220,294-312 (the calm day's drift: no wisps, DRIFT_GRAINS_CALM_SHARE 0.06 of DRIFT_GRAINS_A_CELL 20,000 grains on each 14 m cell, CELLS_OUT 2 so five by five cells round the player, DRIFT_HIGH_CALM 0.4 m, DRIFT_GRAIN_M 0.03, DRIFT_GRAIN_THICKNESS 0.7 faded in and out over each grain's life, three quarters on the whole), game/outside/dust/dust_grains.gd:24-38,106-117 (the unshaded speck in MARS_DUST #b4583a lifted by GRAIN_LIFT 1.25); the game's grains are thrown at random by the card each frame and follow the player, so the stage hangs one moment's worth at random from its own fixed seed over the 70 m square round the camp's middle, standing still

beams.name: mast_beam
beams.from: camp_mast.gd:11-23,26-45,121-145 (the beam: an open CylinderMesh of 8 sides, BEAM_WIDE_M 1.6 across, from the mast's top MAST_HEIGHT_M 12 to BEAM_HEIGHT_M 2,500 m over its foot along the mast's own up, never thinner than LEAST_HALF_ANGLE 0.0035 either side seen from the eye), camp_beam.gdshader (unshaded, added over what is behind it, both sides, Palette.CAMP_BEACON #74b9ea times GLOW 0.6), expedition_camp.gd:17,112,311 (the mast stands straight out from Mars at the camp seat's (10, -10)); its foot here the made mast's own (the foot of the column of campgrounds' mast_1 as this stage stands it through its `grounds` place, its column 12.0 m tall), its up straight out from Mars's middle under this frame (tools/usd/ground.py); turned from the habitat's frame into the camp seat's

sky_dome.from: the framework's (2026-10-11, paper-vs-world-1 item 17: Mars's sky a flat brown wall with no sun): tools/usd/mars_sky.py's single scattering of a dust layer seen from its floor, lit by this record's sun. Albedo 0.975 in red is Wolff et al. 2009's at 650 nm as Chen-Chen et al. 2019 (MSL Navcam) take it; green and blue lower, as Wolff et al. found the dust takes more blue (0.93 and 0.86 are the framework's, not quoted); forward throw 0.67 is Chen-Chen et al. 2019's Navcam retrieval (0.673 +- 0.081); depth 0.6 the framework's choice for a clear afternoon outside the storm season; diffuse the framework's. The gain is measured: the light stage's sweep of the rendered sky against concept K05's, 4 times the first guess (2.94, 1.89, 1.26) nearest it (colour gap 10.7 levels); the camp grounds' own stage takes the camp's sky as it is (one Mars, one sky), lit by its own record's sun

game_only: the dust's life over time: the effects layer of the habitat's stage (data/effects/camp.json) carries the drift and the dust devils round the camp's middle, seen here through the habitat
